notes.title: Clock Simulator: Withdrawal from the Steam store
notes.notes:
Hello!

We'd like to share with you an important update regarding Clock Simulator as the game [b]will be removed from Steam on March 19[/b].

Everyone who purchased it will still have access to it from the games library. The same goes for those who decide to buy the game in the coming days - prior to March 19.

Clock Simulator is purely a single-player experience and due to our actions, you won't lose access to any major features. 

Sorry for the inconvenience!

notes.title: Our new game - Estiman - now on Greenlight
notes.notes:
Stop clocking for a few second - we've got something new! Once again we're turning something so omnipresent and intuitive you'd never even stop to give it thought into an engaging and original game concept. Our upcoming title - [url=http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=783105620]Estiman[/url] - is an arcade visual puzzle game of reflexes and wits that engages the player in its mesmerizing flow one exciting combo after another.

[b]The game is almost ready for distribution, and we need YOUR VOTE on our [url=http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=783105620]Steam Greenlight page[/url], so we can bring it to you in November at our favorite $1 / 1€ price point.[/b]

Estiman is: 
[list]
[*]A unique, endless game of reflexes and wits with original estimation-based gameplay 
[*]A dopamine booster with satisfying combos a skilled player can keep going forever 
[*]A minimal audio-visual experience that evolves as you play 
[*]A fantastic selection of game-altering modes and settings 
[*]A limitless gameplay that pleasantly flows and keeps you hooked
[/list]
Drop by the [url=http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=783105620]Estiman Greenlight profile[/url], and tell us what what you think!

notes.title: Alien invasion time!
notes.notes:
Kool2Play keeps on making games, but that does not mean we're dropping development of everyone's favorite Clock Simulator. Inspired by the launch of our brand new mobile game - [url=www.kool2play.com/eng#games/dungeonsaliens]Dungeons & Aliens[/url]here's yet another freshly made gameplay mode!

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25717702/dca05fa3deb73106b20c895a4284f35bc63ccd6e.jpg[/img]

You might think we'll demand money for such magnificence? Paid DLC? Wrong! Not  here, not ever. In-game payments? Wrong number! The new mode is completely free to all current and coming game owners. Rejoice, and witness the glory of a dwarven mage and not one, but two cuckoo-clocks. No, scratch that. Make that two UFO-clocks. But beware - your inner sense of rhythm will only help you to some extent.

notes.title: The RPS Summer Games: Clock Simulator
notes.notes:
First up on the RPS Summer Games schedule is Clock Simulator [official site]. Such a simple game – all you have to do is click your mouse in time with the passing of each second – tick, tock, tick, tock. We’ll be playing the mode called The Fragility Of Time where you’re only allowed to miss the beat five times. Find out which of RPS has learned to embrace their inner metronome…

… [visit site to read more]

notes.title: FPS limiter
notes.notes: Lots of players were saying something along the lines of "my clock is too fast/too slow", so we've added an option to set an FPS limit in in-game settings. Please tell us if it works for you and how it changed the smoothness of gameplay! ːclockworkcogsː

notes.title: Steam trading cards! YouTube fame! And bugfixes, etc.
notes.notes:
[b]Finally! They are here! Steam trading cards are waiting for you to be collected.[/b]
When you'll have the whole deck, transform it into a badge, to show the world how good piece of a clock you are. Five levels represents different clocks, ranging from the basic one (sundial) to the most precise one (atomic clock).

So, how good do you clock?

As to fame: Clock Simulator is gaining it on YouTube, where more and more videos are being made about our game. One of polish YouTubers, CyDi, found a bug regarding changing in-game language, which is now fixed. As a token of appreciation, CyDi got a couple of keys to distribute.

To make it easier for YouTubers to record our game, we lowered the volume of some in-game ambient sounds.

Also, the russian in-game language has been made available to you. Friends from Russian Federation, thank you for your support!

notes.title: Tick Tock Pig O Clock: It s Clock Simulator
notes.notes:
Clock Simulator [official site]. It’s one of those games that sounds like a joke. Something along the lines of Goat Simulator. But I played it out of curiosity and it’s a weird and interesting thing.

I’m going to caveat this by saying it’s entirely possible that you’d play it and still think it was a joke along the lines of Goat Simulator because all you’re really doing is clicking the mouse or pressing keyboard keys to measure out seconds as they tick by. It’s also repetitive by design and, for me, ridiculously difficult.

… [visit site to read more]

notes.title: Time flies, pigs don't
notes.notes:
The launch of Clock Simulator is already behind us and first feedback is encouraging. Thank you!

We are already working on speeding everything up (some oil into cogs here and there...), simply to adjust the game to your need as soon as we can. Maybe we'll add some steam cards/emoticons? Would you like our Piggy on your trophies list?

Once more, thank you, and KEEP CALM, KEEP CLOCKING!
